hypotheses.justification: `rhoC t` is defined as: `if t ≤ params.phi then 1/2 else if t ≤ params.theta then t/2 - params.b1 else if t ≤ eta then 1 + params.c2 + t else if t ≤ tau then (quadratic) else 0`. The proof uses only `ht.1 : 0 ≤ t`, and only in the phase-2 and phase-3 branches. Phase 4 calls `rhoC_phase4_nonneg hηt hτ`, which needs only `eta ≤ t` and `t ≤ tau`, both taken from the if-conditions. Phases 1 and 5 are constants (`1/2` and `0`). In the phase-2 and phase-3 branches the if-hypothesis `hφ : ¬ t ≤ params.phi` holds. Together with `phi_nonneg : 0 ≤ params.phi`, proved earlier in the same file (Bundle006.lean:662), this gives `0 ≤ t` via `le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt phi_nonneg (lt_of_not_ge hφ))`. That replaces `ht.1`. So `0 ≤ rhoC t` holds for every real `t`, and `ht` can be deleted. The upper bound `t ≤ T` is never used.
